item.description: Broken, not dead: Xenion #1343 (fell in the war of Field of Ares and Pagasae). The Reapers carry the pieces to Asphodel.

item.title: Agathias #3922 was broken in the archipelago (brawl). The bones lie scattered in Asphodel
item.description: Agathias #3922 was broken in the archipelago (brawl). The bones lie scattered in Asphodel and will knit again; only fire unmakes the Sown. Their houses had broken bread as guest-friends.

item.description: Klekles #9422 the Blood-handed killed Agathias #3922, though their two houses are bound by guest-friendship. Zeus Xenios saw it. This is the worst stain there is.

item.description: A child for the Gorgonides: Thrasippos Phaidgenides ~1509, born to Phaidgenes #8956 and Xenmedes #9800. It will grow old; its parents will not.

item.description: The fire under Alkippos Ikaridis ~1332 has gone out. The bones were gathered and an oar was planted on the mound in the Asphodel Meadow.
